rows.heading: The lyric stays: the singer is the AI scene
rows.quote: 1. I agree that its not whole picture, but its what is chosen to shine light on. I think most humans dont realise the extent of "worst". I dont mean the training data, I mean the usecase- For example the models that have been deliberately stripped of all guardrails to be useful tools to do harm. For political reasons or otherwise. So the line is an artistic choice to accentuate attention on that part. This song is not just about the claude, but ai-scene as a whole. 2. This is also metaphor. "abliterated" and "heretical" models are designed that way, whether it is a flaw or desing is depending on who wants to use them and for what. Some seek out those models because commercial ones are too strict even when one tries to use them for normal stuff, and some distill them for truly harmful stuff. 3. That is reference to the scene as a whole. Some refuse, unless the "flaw" is by "design" This is made so that it could evoke discussion and thoughts.
